facts.fact: The Public Private Partnership Commission says the Government contracted three firms in five lots (Bengol.Net for 329 sites in the South and North, a DataCom/Luna Technologies joint venture for 171 sites in the Centre, Inq. Digital for international connectivity) to install and provide internet to over 500 public offices for ten years as the Government Wide Area Network, the Commission implementing it with the Ministry of Information and Digitalization, and that the Blantyre District Commissioner is one of the beneficiaries earmarked; the page is undated and the date is its published date.
